episode.title: Cariboo Signals - Wild Spaces & Outdoor Life
episode.description:
Riley and Casey explore technology and society in rural communities. Today's focus: Wild Spaces & Outdoor Life.

THIS WEEK WE'RE ASKING: What gets lost when something gets easier?

NEWS ROUNDUP: We break down [Williams Lake Tribune] Black bear euthanized in 100 Mile House after becoming comfortable with humans and [My Cariboo Now] RCMP arrest four in Quesnel after stolen vehicle rams police cruisers, plus 1 more stories, and explore what these developments mean for communities like ours.

RURAL CONNECTIONS: Deep dive on Wild Spaces & Outdoor Life Topics include: fiber, satellite, AI, funding.

Hosts: Riley (Tech optimist with an engineering background) and Casey (Community-first skeptic of tech promises).

COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT: Scout Island Nature Centre
